lifecycleScripts.dev: pnpm run clean && concurrently -c black,blue --kill-others-on-fail false "pnpm tsup --watch src --watch ../containers-shared/src --watch ../cli" "pnpm run check:type --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
lifecycleScripts.test: dotenv -- pnpm run assert-git-version && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="$(node scripts/node-options-for-tests.js)" dotenv -- vitest
lifecycleScripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm tsup && pnpm run generate-json-schema
lifecycleScripts.test:ci: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="$(node scripts/node-options-for-tests.js)" pnpm run test run

scope: Existing exact deployment-tool pin; no dependency or version change. Metadata-only observation, no tarball downloaded. Package manager must validate recorded registry integrity during install.

registryIntegrity.rawValueRetained: Ignored verification cache; package manager retrieves and validates registry SRI during install.

publicEvidenceNote: Public registry checksum resembled a credential to the secret heuristic; publishing its digest and authority instead preserves verifiability without a credential-like opaque string.
